accepted.s: Under the Thirteenth Schedule of the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014, within what period were the Indian Railways required to examine establishing a new railway zone in the successor State of Andhra Pradesh?
o: Three months from the appointed day
Two years from the appointed day
One year from the appointed day
Six months from the appointed day
accepted.x: The Act required the Indian Railways to examine establishing a new railway zone in Andhra Pradesh within six months from the appointed day.
accepted.tq: Fix the exact statutory time limit instead of confusing examination with establishment.
accepted.sec: Thirteenth Schedule commitment - wording of the railway zone promise

accepted.s: Which one of the following most accurately describes the obligation relating to the proposed railway zone in Andhra Pradesh under the Thirteenth Schedule?
o: Railways was required to examine establishing the zone and take an expeditious decision
The State Government was authorised to establish the zone independently
The Union Cabinet was required to establish the zone through a constitutional amendment
Railways was required to establish the zone within six months
accepted.x: The statutory wording created a feasibility-oriented obligation to examine the establishment of a zone and take an expeditious decision; it did not itself establish the zone.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the legally precise word 'examine' from the stronger word 'establish'.
accepted.sec: Thirteenth Schedule commitment - wording of the railway zone promise

accepted.s: The wording relating to the proposed railway zone in Andhra Pradesh followed the same pattern as the provisions concerning which of the following?
o: Metro rail, shipyard and fertilizer plant
Steel plant, refinery and airport
Power plant, textile park and industrial corridor
Rail Coach Factory, inland waterways and ports
accepted.x: The railway-zone provision, like the provisions for a steel plant, refinery and airport, required examination and an expeditious decision rather than directly mandating establishment.
accepted.tq: Use the associated-list recall method for provisions carrying the same wording pattern.
accepted.sec: Thirteenth Schedule commitment - wording of the railway zone promise

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. The Thirteenth Schedule also asks Railways to examine a Rail Coach Factory for Telangana.
2. The Rail Coach Factory provision is the same as the new railway-zone provision for Andhra Pradesh.
3. The railway-zone provision concerns the successor State of Andhra Pradesh.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 and 2 only
2 and 3 only
1 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
accepted.x: Statements 1 and 3 are correct. Statement 2 is false because the Rail Coach Factory provision for Telangana must not be confused with the railway-zone provision for Andhra Pradesh.
accepted.tq: Separate two similar Thirteenth Schedule provisions by their State and subject.
accepted.sec: Thirteenth Schedule commitment - wording of the railway zone promise

accepted.s: Railways is a Union subject under which entry of the Union List?
o: Entry 27
Entry 24
Entry 30
Entry 22
accepted.x: Railways falls under Entry 22 of List I, the Union List.
accepted.tq: Recall the exact constitutional entry associated with the subject.
accepted.sec: Thirteenth Schedule commitment - wording of the railway zone promise

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding the creation of a railway zone is correct?
o: A railway zone is created by an executive decision and gazette notification of the Ministry of Railways
A railway zone is created by the Finance Commission through an annual budget resolution
A railway zone is created automatically when a State is reorganised
A railway zone can be created only by an Act of the State Legislature
accepted.x: Creation of a railway zone is an executive decision followed by a gazette notification of the Ministry of Railways.
accepted.tq: Ask which authority would perform the administrative act rather than the legislative one.
accepted.sec: Thirteenth Schedule commitment - wording of the railway zone promise

accepted.s: South Coast Railway was announced in which year and was proposed to be carved out of which two railway zones?
o: 2019; South Central Railway and East Coast Railway
2021; East Coast Railway and Central Railway
2020; South Central Railway and Southern Railway
2018; East Coast Railway and North Central Railway
accepted.x: South Coast Railway was announced in 2019 in the Rail Budget and was to be carved out of South Central Railway and East Coast Railway.
accepted.tq: Combine the announcement year with the two parent zones without swapping neighbouring railway zones.
accepted.sec: South Coast Railway zone - headquarters, announcement year, divisions

accepted.s: The South Coast Railway zone was officially notified in the Gazette on:
o: 1 June 2026
3 February 2026
30 March 2026
accepted.x: The Gazette notification establishing South Coast Railway was issued on 4 May 2026.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the notification date from the later date of full operationalisation.
accepted.sec: South Coast Railway zone - headquarters, announcement year, divisions

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about South Coast Railway:
1. Its headquarters is at Visakhapatnam.
2. Its area includes Andhra Pradesh and parts of Karnataka, Telangana and Tamil Nadu.
3. Sandeep Mathur is its General Manager.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 only
1 and 2 only
2 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: the headquarters is Visakhapatnam, the zone covers the stated States and Sandeep Mathur is the General Manager.
accepted.tq: Test a compact cluster of administrative identity, territorial coverage and leadership facts.
accepted.sec: South Coast Railway zone - headquarters, announcement year, divisions

accepted.s: With effect from 1 June 2026, the Indian Railways logo was revised to contain:
o: 19 stars instead of 18
16 stars instead of 15
17 stars instead of 16
18 stars instead of 17
accepted.x: The Indian Railways logo was revised from 17 stars to 18 stars with effect from 1 June 2026.
accepted.tq: Use the before-and-after numerical comparison rather than the final figure alone.
accepted.sec: South Coast Railway zone - headquarters, announcement year, divisions

accepted.s: After the creation of South Coast Railway, which statement about South Central Railway is correct?
o: It retained all six divisions and covered 3,584 km
It was left with two divisions—Secunderabad and Hyderabad—and covered 3,584 km
It was left with three divisions—Secunderabad, Hyderabad and Nanded—and still covered 3,584 km
It was left with four divisions—Secunderabad, Hyderabad, Nanded and Vijayawada—and covered 2,584 km
accepted.x: South Central Railway was reduced from six to three divisions—Secunderabad, Hyderabad and Nanded—but continued to cover 3,584 km.
accepted.tq: Check both the change in division count and the unchanged route-length figure.
accepted.sec: South Coast Railway zone - headquarters, announcement year, divisions

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements is NOT correct regarding the number of railway zones in India and Konkan Railway?
o: Some lists show 19 by counting Konkan Railway as a separate zone
Konkan Railway has its headquarters at Visakhapatnam
Konkan Railway is a public sector undertaking and not a railway zone
The number of railway zones is 18
accepted.x: Konkan Railway is not a railway zone; it is KRCL, a PSU headquartered at Navi Mumbai—CBD Belapur. Therefore, its headquarters is not Visakhapatnam.
accepted.tq: Find the wrong location in an otherwise familiar comparison between zones and a railway PSU.
accepted.sec: South Coast Railway zone - headquarters, announcement year, divisions

accepted.s: Konkan Railway Corporation Limited, which is not counted as a railway zone, was established on:
o: 26 January 1998
1 June 2001
26 January 2000
15 August 1998
accepted.x: Konkan Railway Corporation Limited was established on 26 January 1998 and has its headquarters at Navi Mumbai—CBD Belapur.
accepted.tq: Recall the exact date attached to the non-zone railway organisation.
accepted.sec: South Coast Railway zone - headquarters, announcement year, divisions

accepted.s: What was the principal administrative fate of the Waltair division after the formation of South Coast Railway?
o: Its Andhra part became Visakhapatnam division of South Coast Railway and the rest became Rayagada division of East Coast Railway
It was abolished without creating any successor division
It remained wholly under East Coast Railway
It was transferred wholly to South Central Railway as Guntakal division
accepted.x: Waltair was split: its Andhra portion became the truncated Visakhapatnam division of South Coast Railway, while the remaining portion went to East Coast Railway as the new Rayagada division.
accepted.tq: Track the split of one old division into two new administrative units.
accepted.sec: Waltair division - fate after the new zone

accepted.s: The Kottavalasa–Kirandul line became a major point of dispute mainly because it was regarded as:
o: The principal suburban line of Vijayawada
The only passenger line of Guntakal division
The headquarters route of South Central Railway
The revenue lifeline of Waltair division
accepted.x: The Kottavalasa–Kirandul line was described as the revenue lifeline of Waltair division and therefore became the central flashpoint in the reorganisation dispute.
accepted.tq: Identify the functional significance of the disputed asset before considering competing claims.
accepted.sec: Waltair division - fate after the new zone

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly states the positions concerning the Kottavalasa–Kirandul line?
o: Andhra Pradesh claimed the entire line, while the Centre favoured moving it to Vijayawada
Odisha claimed the entire line, while the Centre favoured moving the entire line to Rayagada
Odisha offered the entire line to South Coast Railway, while Andhra Pradesh opposed any transfer
Both Odisha and Andhra Pradesh agreed that the line should remain wholly with Waltair
accepted.x: Odisha claimed the entire K-K line, and the Centre favoured shifting the entire line to the Rayagada division.
accepted.tq: Separate the positions of the claimant State and the Union Government instead of treating them as identical.
accepted.sec: Waltair division - fate after the new zone

accepted.s: Which of the following represents Andhra Pradesh's position regarding the Kottavalasa–Kirandul line?
o: It offered only the Odisha stretches—Koraput–Kirandul, Kuneru–Theruvali and Koraput–Rayagada
It offered only the Vijayawada–Guntakal stretch
It offered the entire line to Odisha without any reservation
It demanded that the entire line be transferred to Telangana
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh leaders offered only the Odisha stretches of the line, namely Koraput–Kirandul, Kuneru–Theruvali and Koraput–Rayagada.
accepted.tq: Test the exact components of a limited offer rather than the broader claim over the whole line.
accepted.sec: Waltair division - fate after the new zone

accepted.s: Andhra Pradesh leaders argued that Waltair division had earned more revenue than which combination of divisions?
o: Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada and Secunderabad
Vijayawada, Guntur and Guntakal
Secunderabad, Hyderabad and Nanded
Khurda Road, Sambalpur and Rayagada
accepted.x: The Andhra Pradesh position was that Waltair had earned more than Vijayawada, Guntur and Guntakal combined.
accepted.tq: Use the revenue comparison to distinguish the disputed division from the three divisions named alongside it.
accepted.sec: Waltair division - fate after the new zone

accepted.s:
Arrange the following developments in chronological order:
A. South Coast Railway becomes fully operational
B. South Coast Railway is announced
C. Gazette notification of South Coast Railway
D. The Act requires Railways to examine a new zone
o: D, B, C, A
B, D, C, A
D, C, B, A
B, C, D, A
accepted.x: The correct sequence is 2014 statutory provision, 2019 announcement, 4 May 2026 Gazette notification and 1 June 2026 full operationalisation.
accepted.tq: Fix the earliest statutory event first, then place announcement, notification and operation.
accepted.sec: Status - DPR, land allotment, office construction, operationalisation

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements about the status of South Coast Railway before its Gazette notification is correct?
o: The General Manager appointed in March 2026 had full statutory powers immediately
The General Manager appointed in March 2026 had no powers without the Gazette notification
The zone's headquarters had already been completed in February 2026
The zone was fully operational in March 2026 despite the absence of notification
accepted.x: Although a General Manager was appointed in March 2026, the office had no powers until the Gazette notification was issued.
accepted.tq: Apply the difference between an appointment and the legal operational authority created by notification.
accepted.sec: Status - DPR, land allotment, office construction, operationalisation

accepted.s: Which of the following correctly describes the April 2026 administrative arrangements for South Coast Railway?
o: Land-handover disputes were resolved, a temporary office was functioning at Siripuram with about 100 staff, and more than 1,300 posts were being filled
Land disputes remained unresolved, and all staff were shifted to Rayagada
The permanent headquarters at Mudasarlova began functioning with 1,300 staff
The temporary office was established at Vijayawada with 526 staff
accepted.x: In April 2026, land-handover disputes for the Visakhapatnam headquarters were resolved; a temporary office at Siripuram had about 100 staff and over 1,300 posts were being filled.
accepted.tq: Combine location, staffing and administrative progress while rejecting the premature permanent-office claim.
accepted.sec: Status - DPR, land allotment, office construction, operationalisation

accepted.s: The proposed zonal headquarters of South Coast Railway at Mudasarlova, Visakhapatnam, is estimated to cost:
o: ₹84 crore
₹124 crore
₹184 crore
₹284 crore
accepted.x: The proposed zonal headquarters at Mudasarlova, Visakhapatnam, is a ₹184-crore project; meanwhile, the zone works from a VMRDA building.
accepted.tq: Recall the exact project cost and distinguish the proposed headquarters from the temporary office.
accepted.sec: Status - DPR, land allotment, office construction, operationalisation

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly reflects the staffing position mentioned for South Coast Railway headquarters and Rayagada division?
o: 183 of 191 headquarters posts and 47 of 526 Rayagada posts were filled
All 526 headquarters posts and 191 Rayagada posts were filled
526 of 183 headquarters posts and 191 of 47 Rayagada posts were filled
183 of 526 headquarters posts and 47 of 191 Rayagada posts were filled
accepted.x: Only 183 of 526 headquarters posts and 47 of 191 Rayagada posts had been filled. A Railway Board note attributed the gap to poor cooperation from existing zones.
accepted.tq: Read numerator and sanctioned-post denominator carefully in both staffing figures.
accepted.sec: Status - DPR, land allotment, office construction, operationalisation

accepted.s: The Railway Board note of 14 May 2026 attributed the staffing gap in the new railway zone mainly to:
o: The cancellation of the Gazette notification
Poor cooperation from existing railway zones
Absence of a General Manager
Lack of land in Visakhapatnam
accepted.x: The Railway Board note blamed poor cooperation from existing zones for the staffing gap.
accepted.tq: Match the administrative problem with the stated institutional cause.
accepted.sec: Status - DPR, land allotment, office construction, operationalisation

accepted.s: In the first four months, the approximate gross originating revenue of Vijayawada division was:
o: ₹2,894 crore
₹3,894 crore
₹4,894 crore
₹5,894 crore
accepted.x: Vijayawada division recorded approximately ₹4,894 crore in gross originating revenue during its first four months.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the reported revenue figure from nearby altered figures.
accepted.sec: Status - DPR, land allotment, office construction, operationalisation

accepted.s: Which of the following is correctly associated with the approved remodelling of Visakhapatnam station yard?
o: ₹400 crore and eight new platforms, making a total of sixteen
₹300 crore and six new platforms, making a total of fourteen
₹100 crore and four new platforms, making a total of ten
₹200 crore and five new platforms, making a total of twelve
accepted.x: A ₹300-crore remodelling project was approved for Visakhapatnam station yard, involving six new platforms and taking the total to 14.
accepted.tq: Link the project cost with both platform additions and the final platform count.
accepted.sec: Status - DPR, land allotment, office construction, operationalisation

accepted.s: Which one of the following correctly describes the impact of South Coast Railway on East Coast Railway and the Kottavalasa–Kirandul line?
o: East Coast Railway is dissolved after the creation of South Coast Railway
East Coast Railway loses both the Andhra part of Waltair and all K-K line revenue
East Coast Railway gains the Andhra part of Waltair and transfers Rayagada to South Central Railway
East Coast Railway loses the Andhra part of Waltair but retains the K-K line revenue through Rayagada division
accepted.x: East Coast Railway loses the Andhra part of Waltair, but it retains the K-K line revenue through the new Rayagada division.
accepted.tq: Track what is transferred and what revenue source is retained by the existing zone.
accepted.sec: Issues - impact on East Coast Railway, neighbouring state positions

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the positions of the neighbouring States and railway zones:
1. Odisha claimed the entire Kottavalasa–Kirandul line.
2. Andhra Pradesh objected that backward Uttarandhra areas would go to Rayagada.
3. South Central Railway was reduced to three divisions.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
o: 1 and 2 only
2 and 3 only
1 and 3 only
1, 2 and 3
accepted.x: All three statements are correct. Odisha claimed the entire K-K line, Andhra Pradesh raised concerns regarding backward Uttarandhra areas, and SCR shrank to three divisions.
accepted.tq: Combine the positions of Odisha and Andhra Pradesh with the institutional impact on SCR.
accepted.sec: Issues - impact on East Coast Railway, neighbouring state positions

accepted.s: The establishment of South Coast Railway was described as significant because it was:
o: A demand pressed for over four decades and a statutory promise made in 2014, but notified only after a decade
A constitutional obligation implemented within six months of bifurcation
A demand raised for the first time in 2019 and implemented immediately
A proposal made only after the 2026 Gazette notification
accepted.x: The demand had been pressed for over four decades, while the statutory promise dated from 2014; the zone was notified only after about a decade.
accepted.tq: Compare the duration of the demand with the delay between statutory promise and notification.
accepted.sec: Issues - impact on East Coast Railway, neighbouring state positions

accepted.s: Who described the notification of South Coast Railway as a “promise kept”?
o: The General Manager of East Coast Railway
Ashwini Vaishnaw
N. Chandrababu Naidu
Sandeep Mathur
accepted.x: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu described the notification as a “promise kept”.
accepted.tq: Match the quoted political statement with the correct office-holder.
accepted.sec: Issues - impact on East Coast Railway, neighbouring state positions
